title: The Photo of the Yemeni Girl

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Tyler, can you describe the photograph?
sentences.zh: 泰勒，你能描述一下这张照片吗？

sentences.en: It's a young girl laying on her back on a dark cot in a hospital, and she's got brown hair that's pulled back behind one ear, and her face looks like any child of her age,
sentences.zh: 那是一个小女孩，躺在医院一张昏暗的帆布床上，她留着棕色的头发，头发别在耳后，她的脸看起来和同龄的孩子没什么两样，

sentences.en: a seven-year-old girl looking to one side, very pretty, very calm.
sentences.zh: 一个七岁的小女孩，侧着头，非常漂亮，非常平静。

sentences.en: But below the neck, you see this incredibly malnourished body.
sentences.zh: 但在脖子以下，你能看到那具极度营养不良的身体。

sentences.en: Her ribs are literally popping through her skin.
sentences.zh: 她的肋骨简直要从皮肤里凸出来了。

sentences.en: The hands and arms are incredibly skinny.
sentences.zh: 手和手臂瘦得惊人。

sentences.en: She's kind of clutching her own body with her hands, almost like she's holding on to what's left.
sentences.zh: 她用手抓着自己的身体，就像在紧紧抓住仅存的一点生命。

sentences.en: And you can see actually on her right hand, there's a fly on her thumb, and she doesn't have the energy to push it away.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以看到她右手大拇指上停着一只苍蝇，而她已经没有力气把它赶走了。

sentences.en: It just sat there.
sentences.zh: 它就那样停在那儿。

sentences.en: And you took this photograph?
sentences.zh: 这张照片是你拍的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I took this photograph at a small clinic, not even a hospital, but really a field clinic in northern Yemen during a recent assignment there.
sentences.zh: 我是在也门北部的一次任务中，在一家小诊所拍下这张照片的，那甚至算不上医院，只是一个野战诊所。

sentences.en: I'm reluctant to display this picture, though it was on the front page of a major newspaper in the
sentences.zh: 虽然这张照片曾登上美国一家主要报纸的头版，但我其实并不愿意展示它。

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: Amal Hussein, she's a victim of famine in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 阿迈勒·侯赛因，她是也门饥荒的受害者。

sentences.en: This is what the decision is all about on the floor of the United States Senate.
sentences.zh: 这就是美国参议院正在辩论的核心议题。

sentences.en: Will we continue to expend American taxpayer dollars, even American lives, in support of the Saudi regime and their invasion in the war in Yemen?
sentences.zh: 我们是否还要继续耗费美国纳税人的钱，甚至牺牲美国人的生命，去支持沙特政权及其在也门的入侵战争？

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: I understand the threat of Iran, and I understand we have to stand up to their aggression when and where it takes place.
sentences.zh: 我理解伊朗带来的威胁，也明白我们必须在必要的时间和地点反击他们的侵略。

sentences.en: But did we enlist in this war?
sentences.zh: 但我们当初加入这场战争了吗？

sentences.en: Did the American people have a national debate about this war?
sentences.zh: 美国人民是否就这场战争进行过全国性的辩论？

sentences.en: Did we vote in the United States Senate to engage in this war?
sentences.zh: 我们美国参议院是否投票决定参与这场战争？

sentences.en: The answer is clearly no.
sentences.zh: 答案显然是否定的。

sentences.en: In the three years that Saudi Arabia, supported by the United States, has been at war with the
sentences.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯在美国的支持下与也门胡塞武装交战的三年里，

sentences.en: Houthis in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装。

sentences.en: Very few journalists have been allowed into the country to document what's happening there as a result of the war.
sentences.zh: 很少有记者被允许进入该国记录战争造成的后果。

sentences.en: Times photojournalist Tyler Hicks is one of them.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》摄影记者泰勒·希克斯就是其中之一。

sentences.en: This is the story of how he came to take that photograph of Amal Hussein.
sentences.zh: 这就是他拍摄那张阿迈勒·侯赛因照片背后的故事。

sentences.en: It's Friday, December 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月7日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, the north is where more of the humanitarian crisis is taking place.
sentences.zh: 北部是人道主义危机最严重的地方。

sentences.en: To go to the north, you're crossing from the government-backed Yemeni fighters to the Houthis side, who are still in control of Sanaa, the capital.
sentences.zh: 要前往北部，你得从政府支持的也门武装人员控制区穿过，进入胡塞武装控制区，他们目前仍控制着首都萨那。

sentences.en: Once we cross into Houthi territory, this is where things became more controlled.
sentences.zh: 一旦进入胡塞武装控制区，情况就变得更加受限了。

sentences.en: We have to have a minder.
sentences.zh: 我们必须有随行人员。

sentences.en: To a government person who's watching over.
sentences.zh: 也就是负责监视我们的政府人员。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're with you everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们如影随形。

sentences.en: So, as I'm taking pictures, that person is either at my side or close by, keeping an eye on me.
sentences.zh: 所以当我拍照时，那个人要么在我身边，要么就在附近盯着我。

sentences.en: A lot of that has to do with, they don't want photographs of bridges and government buildings and any kind of sensitive things.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上是因为他们不想让桥梁、政府大楼或任何敏感设施被拍到。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But what we wanted to really see was the malnutrition, which we'd heard so much about.
sentences.zh: 但我们真正想看的是我们听闻已久的营养不良问题。

sentences.en: There's malnutrition, there's cholera, and it's affecting not only children, but the parents.
sentences.zh: 那里不仅有营养不良，还有霍乱，受影响的不仅是孩子，还有他们的父母。

sentences.en: And this all has to do with the fact that the economy is so destroyed there.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与当地经济彻底崩溃有关。

sentences.en: There are no jobs.
sentences.zh: 没有工作。

sentences.en: There's no money flowing into the hands of people.
sentences.zh: 人们手里没有钱。

sentences.en: Now, this isn't something where there's actually no food.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说真的没有食物。

sentences.en: This isn't a drought.
sentences.zh: 这不是旱灾。

sentences.en: The food is there.
sentences.zh: 食物是有的。

sentences.en: People have no ability to purchase it.
sentences.zh: 只是人们没有能力购买。

sentences.en: These are the areas that we wanted to go and see how these people were doing.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我们想去看看人们生活状况的地方。

sentences.en: And after a couple days, I finally was on my way to a small town called Aslam.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我终于前往了一个叫阿斯拉姆的小镇。

sentences.en: And there, there's a little clinic.
sentences.zh: 那里有一家小诊所。

sentences.en: It's not what you would expect as a big hospital where people are flooding in.
sentences.zh: 它不像你想象中那种人满为患的大医院。

sentences.en: I was actually surprised when I arrived there in the parking lot because it's just a little white building and a compound.
sentences.zh: 我到达停车场时其实很惊讶，因为那只是一个带院子的小白楼。

sentences.en: Not really, um, anyone outside.
sentences.zh: 外面几乎没有人。

sentences.en: One or two people, a guard walking around.
sentences.zh: 只有一两个人，还有一个走来走去的警卫。

sentences.en: And I thought, what's going to be here?
sentences.zh: 我心想，这里会有什么呢？

sentences.en: This doesn't look like much.
sentences.zh: 看起来不像有什么东西。

sentences.en: But once I got inside, within seconds, I could see how serious the situation was.
sentences.zh: 但一旦进去，几秒钟内我就意识到情况有多严重。

sentences.en: Most of the doors were open.
sentences.zh: 大部分房门都是开着的。

sentences.en: And just looking in from outside of the rooms looking in, you could see that there are these children, some laying on cots, some being held by their mothers that were
sentences.zh: 从房间外面往里看，你能看到那些孩子，有的躺在帆布床上，有的被母亲抱着，他们营养不良的程度令人震惊。

sentences.en: so malnourished that it was really shocking.
sentences.zh: 营养不良。

sentences.en: And I knew that I had arrived at the place where I could really document the reality of what was happening in the country to these people.
sentences.zh: 我知道我来到了一个真正能记录下这个国家人民真实遭遇的地方。

sentences.en: And that is that children are starving to death.
sentences.zh: 那就是孩子们正在饿死。

sentences.en: When I arrived, I, you know, my immediate instinct was just to rush to these rooms and to start taking photographs.
sentences.zh: 我刚到的时候，第一直觉就是冲进这些房间开始拍照。

sentences.en: But culturally, to photograph women there is not as open as it is in the WeSt. And I definitely don't blend in in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 但在文化上，在那里拍摄女性并不像在西方那样开放。而且我的外表和穿着在也门显然格格不入。

sentences.en: When I walk into a place, it's very clear that I'm a foreigner by the way I look, the way I dress.
sentences.zh: 当我走进一个地方，从我的长相和穿着就能一眼看出我是外国人。

sentences.en: I'm carrying big cameras.
sentences.zh: 我背着大相机。

sentences.en: There's no question in their mind that this person comes from away.
sentences.zh: 他们毫无疑问会认为这个人是从远方来的。

sentences.en: And so I asked a nurse, to explain to the families that there's a photographer there that we want to show what's happening to them, what their condition, their suffering.
sentences.zh: 所以我请了一位护士向家属解释，说有一位摄影师想展示他们正在经历的苦难和状况。

sentences.en: So they first went around into each of these rooms and talked to the people and not a single one of them objected.
sentences.zh: 于是她先去每个房间和人们沟通，没有一个人反对。

sentences.en: These people have been through so much that I think that at that point, the concern about having their picture made
sentences.zh: 这些人经历的苦难太多了，我想在那一刻，对于被拍照或展示孩子生命中最糟糕时刻的顾虑，都被有人愿意倾听的渴望所掩盖了。

sentences.en: or showing their child at the lowest point of their lives, those concerns are overshadowed by somebody there who's willing to listen.
sentences.zh: 展示他们的孩子。

sentences.en: There's no explanation for it other than that it's just an amazing understanding that happens between human beings sometimes.
sentences.zh: 除了人类之间有时会产生的那种奇妙的共鸣外，没有其他解释。

sentences.en: So one of the first children that I saw was a young girl, seven years old, named Amal, who I could see
sentences.zh: 我见到的第一个孩子是一个七岁的小女孩，名叫阿迈勒，我甚至在房间外面就能看到，

sentences.en: even from outside the room, this skeletal figure laying on a cot.
sentences.zh: 那具躺在帆布床上的骷髅般的身影。

sentences.en: Her mother was sitting at the foot of the bed and she virtually could barely move.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲坐在床脚，几乎动弹不得。

sentences.en: She was just skin and bones laying there.
sentences.zh: 她躺在那里，只剩下皮包骨头。

sentences.en: But with this very peaceful and calm look on her face, her head tilted to the side, she never lifted her head.
sentences.zh: 但她的脸上带着一种非常平静安详的神情，头歪向一边，她从未抬起过头。

sentences.en: She never looked up towards me.
sentences.zh: 她从未抬头看我。

sentences.en: She never made any sudden movements.
sentences.zh: 她没有任何突兀的动作。

sentences.en: She was just almost like a statue just laying there.
sentences.zh: 她就像一尊雕像一样躺在那里。

sentences.en: It was clear that she was very, very weak.
sentences.zh: 很明显，她已经非常、非常虚弱了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What did you learn about how this seven-year-old girl, Amal, came to be in that hospital?
sentences.zh: 关于这个七岁女孩阿迈勒是如何住进那家医院的，你了解到了什么？

sentences.en: Amal and her family are originally from a town called Sada in the north.
sentences.zh: 阿迈勒和她的家人原本来自北部的萨达镇。

sentences.en: And this is one of the hardest hit areas by Saudi airstrikes throughout the war.
sentences.zh: 这是整个战争期间受沙特空袭影响最严重的地区之一。

sentences.en: Huge parts of that city are completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 那座城市的大部分地区已被彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: They were forced out of their home as many others had fled from there to escape these bombardments three years ago.
sentences.zh: 三年前，为了躲避轰炸，他们像许多其他人一样被迫逃离家园。

sentences.en: And like so many others ended up in camps for displaced people.
sentences.zh: 像许多人一样，最终流落到了流离失所者营地。

sentences.en: These places are very, very basic, tented, makeshift tents.
sentences.zh: 这些地方非常简陋，都是临时搭建的帐篷。

sentences.en: People build their homes out of sticks and sheets of plastic shrubs.
sentences.zh: 人们用树枝、塑料布和灌木搭建住所。

sentences.en: They're lucky to get clean water and the very basics of food.
sentences.zh: 能有干净的水和最基本的食物就算幸运了。

sentences.en: There's no hospital.
sentences.zh: 那里没有医院。

sentences.en: You know, I visited some of these camps on this trip and it's incredibly difficult living conditions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这次旅行中我参观了一些这样的营地，生活条件极其艰苦。

sentences.en: And it wouldn't surprise anyone that there would be a huge amount of malnutrition and disease that just fester there.
sentences.zh: 如果那里滋生了大量的营养不良和疾病，一点也不让人感到意外。

sentences.en: So you're standing in front of this extremely malnourished child.
sentences.zh: 所以你站在这个极度营养不良的孩子面前。

sentences.en: What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: You know, I'm a news photographer, so things are normally moving very quickly in front of me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是一名新闻摄影师，通常我面前的情况变化很快。

sentences.en: You have to make split-second decisions.
sentences.zh: 你必须在瞬间做出决定。

sentences.en: Things happen behind you, in front of you.
sentences.zh: 事情发生在你身后、你面前。

sentences.en: You're coming in and out of rooms and buildings and outside and inside, and it can be very fast-moving.
sentences.zh: 你进进出出房间、建筑物，从室外到室内，节奏非常快。

sentences.en: So when I am presented with something as stagnant as this, it's a challenge for me.
sentences.zh: 所以当我面对如此静止的画面时，对我来说反而是一种挑战。

sentences.en: It seems like you would just point the camera and here's, you know, this suffering child and take a picture.
sentences.zh: 看起来你只需要把镜头对准这个受苦的孩子拍张照就行了。

sentences.en: But really, I spent a long time to make sure that I got this photograph because I knew it was a very important photograph to show.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，我花了很多时间来确保拍好这张照片，因为我知道这是一张非常重要的照片，必须展示出来。

sentences.en: This particular girl would resonate with people back home.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩会引起家乡人们的共鸣。

sentences.en: And how is it that you knew that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么知道的？

sentences.en: That's difficult to explain.
sentences.zh: 这很难解释。

sentences.en: I've been a photographer for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我做摄影师已经很久了。

sentences.en: I've worked for the New York Times for 18 years, primarily covering conflict, natural disasters, all kinds of wars around the world.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》工作了18年，主要报道冲突、自然灾害以及世界各地的各种战争。

sentences.en: And I've worked in a lot of very difficult places where people are suffering.
sentences.zh: 我在很多人们遭受苦难的艰苦地区工作过。

sentences.en: This is by far the worst condition I've seen, children.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过的最糟糕的情况，尤其是对孩子而言。

sentences.en: And there was something about her face, actually, for me.
sentences.zh: 其实，她的脸有些东西触动了我。

sentences.en: The way that she was looking to the side, the difference between her face and her body.
sentences.zh: 她侧头看的样子，以及她脸部与身体之间的反差。

sentences.en: There's such a separation between this very sweet face and this completely malnourished body that really stood out to me.
sentences.zh: 那张非常甜美的脸庞与那具完全营养不良的身体之间有着巨大的割裂感，这深深地触动了我。

sentences.en: And I spent a lot of time photographing her.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间拍摄她。

sentences.en: There was never any indication that they wanted me to leave or to be rushed.
sentences.zh: 他们从未表现出希望我离开或催促我的意思。

sentences.en: And that's really unusual situation often.
sentences.zh: 这在通常情况下是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: How many photographs of Amal do you think you took?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你拍了多少张阿迈勒的照片？

sentences.en: It's hard to say.
sentences.zh: 很难说。

sentences.en: I certainly took hundreds of photographs of her from various angles, from further back, from up close.
sentences.zh: 我肯定从不同角度、从远处、从近处拍了她几百张照片。

sentences.en: This is a very close-up photograph.
sentences.zh: 这是一张非常近距离的照片。

sentences.en: Some I took even closer.
sentences.zh: 有些我拍得更近。

sentences.en: I photographed just her hands, just her ribs.
sentences.zh: 我只拍了她的手，只拍了她的肋骨。

sentences.en: Really, a lot of different variations to land on the photograph that I really thought would have the impact and would get the attention.
sentences.zh: 真的，尝试了各种不同的角度，才拍到了那张我认为最有冲击力、最能引起关注的照片。

sentences.en: And then I thanked her mother.
sentences.zh: 然后我感谢了她的母亲。

sentences.en: I said in Arabic, thank you, and left the room.
sentences.zh: 我用阿拉伯语说了谢谢，然后离开了房间。

sentences.en: Tyler, what ended up happening to Amal?
sentences.zh: 泰勒，阿迈勒后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well, several days after I took this photograph, we heard that Amal had been discharged from this small clinic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我拍完这张照片几天后，听说阿迈勒已经从那家小诊所出院了。

sentences.en: And I was surprised to hear that because she was in such terrible condition when I saw her.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息我很惊讶，因为我见到她时她的状况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Yet at the same time, I was, you know, gave me some hope that possibly she was being treated and improving.
sentences.zh: 但同时，这也让我有了一丝希望，觉得她可能正在接受治疗并有所好转。

sentences.en: What we later learned was that the doctors encouraged the family to take
sentences.zh: 后来我们了解到，医生建议家属把

sentences.en: Amal to a clinic that was 15 miles away, where they had a lot more ability to help people in this advanced state of malnutrition because her condition was actually deteriorating.
sentences.zh: 阿迈勒送到15英里外的一家诊所，那里有更好的条件救助处于这种严重营养不良状态的病人，因为她的病情实际上在恶化。

sentences.en: However,
sentences.zh: 然而，

sentences.en: her parents didn't have the money even to take her there.
sentences.zh: 她的父母甚至连带她去那里的钱都没有。

sentences.en: Not even 15 miles.
sentences.zh: 连15英里都去不了。

sentences.en: Not even 15 miles.
sentences.zh: 连15英里都去不了。

sentences.en: So they had to just return to their camp just a couple miles away, where Amal died just a few days later.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只能回到离那里只有几英里的营地，几天后，阿迈勒就去世了。

sentences.en: So within about a week or so of you meeting her and taking these photographs,
sentences.zh: 所以从你见到她并拍下这些照片算起，大约一周之内，

sentences.en: she had essentially starved to death.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是活活饿死的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The world's attention has been drawn to the plight of starving children in war-torn Yemen.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的目光都投向了饱受战争蹂躏的也门，关注那里饥饿儿童的困境。

sentences.en: That's after the New York Times published a powerful picture of a dying girl.
sentences.zh: 此前，《纽约时报》刊登了一张令人震撼的垂死女孩的照片。

sentences.en: It was a photo very disturbing, very hard to look at.
sentences.zh: 那是一张非常令人不安、非常不忍直视的照片。

sentences.en: We want to warn you about it because we're going to show it to you in case you missed it, but it's so important to see.
sentences.zh: 我们想提醒您，因为我们打算展示这张照片，以防您错过了，但它确实非常值得一看。

sentences.en: Here's the photo.
sentences.zh: 这就是那张照片。

sentences.en: This is Amal, a seven-year-old girl being treated for severe malnutrition at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是阿迈勒（Amal），当时她是一名七岁的小女孩，正在接受严重的营养不良治疗。

sentences.en: Many readers were struck by her haunting stare.
sentences.zh: 许多读者被她那令人心碎的眼神所震撼。

sentences.en: They wanted to know, well, what happened to her?
sentences.zh: 他们想知道，她后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well, we understand that she died just a week after the photo was published.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，照片发表仅一周后，她就去世了。

sentences.en: What did you think the reaction would be and whether there might be any risk in running an image of that kind of suffering?
sentences.zh: 您当时认为会有什么样的反响？刊登这种苦难的图片是否存在风险？

sentences.en: You know, I don't take photographs like this just for the sake of taking these photographs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我拍摄这样的照片并不是为了拍而拍。

sentences.en: Often, especially in conflict, the hardest to look at photographs are very often not the ones that you take or certainly not the ones that you publish.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，特别是在冲突地区，最难直视的照片往往不是你拍摄的，或者肯定不是你会发表的那些。

sentences.en: There are a lot of ways to illustrate war that do not include blood and gore.
sentences.zh: 有很多方式可以展现战争，而不必包含血腥和暴力。

sentences.en: And I'm always looking for the emotion, the byproducts of that conflict.
sentences.zh: 我一直在寻找情感，寻找冲突带来的后果。

sentences.en: I will always go there firSt. In certain cases, this type of photograph is just, there's no other way to illustrate it.
sentences.zh: 我总是会优先考虑这些。在某些情况下，这种类型的照片是唯一的表现方式，别无他法。

sentences.en: There's no other way to get people to look at it.
sentences.zh: 没有其他办法能让人们去关注它。

sentences.en: There's always going to be some blowback from publishing a photograph like this.
sentences.zh: 发表这样的照片总是会引发一些反弹。

sentences.en: Not everyone understands the value of showing suffering.
sentences.zh: 并非每个人都能理解展示苦难的价值。

sentences.en: They may say, why would you show this?
sentences.zh: 他们可能会问，为什么要展示这些？

sentences.en: But the lesson here is the amount of attention that this photograph got, the amount of attention
sentences.zh: 但其中的教训在于这张照片所获得的关注度，以及它所带来的关注，

sentences.en: that it brought to a conflict that is very undercovered, largely because it is so difficult to get into the country.
sentences.zh: 它让一场被严重忽视的冲突进入了公众视野，很大程度上是因为进入该国非常困难。

sentences.en: And it is a dangerous place to work.
sentences.zh: 而且那是一个危险的工作环境。

sentences.en: And so few journalists actually go there.
sentences.zh: 所以很少有记者真正去那里。

sentences.en: We need to show these photographs.
sentences.zh: 我们需要展示这些照片。

sentences.en: And I would never quarantine something like this from the readers, the viewers of the New York Times, because that would be a disservice to the people that I'm photographing.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会把这样的内容对《纽约时报》的读者和观众进行封锁，因为那将是对我所拍摄对象的一种伤害。

sentences.en: This is an opportunity to tell their story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个讲述他们故事的机会。

sentences.en: There's no other way to do it.
sentences.zh: 没有其他办法能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Very rarely, but occasionally that is the type of image that needs to be shown.
sentences.zh: 虽然非常罕见，但偶尔这就是需要被展示的影像类型。

sentences.en: Especially, you know, still photographed, which I still think taps into a part of our brain that nothing else has the ability to do.
sentences.zh: 特别是静态摄影，我认为它能触及我们大脑中其他任何事物都无法触及的部分。

sentences.en: It forces the viewer to slow down, forces the viewer to study the photograph and get something out of it.
sentences.zh: 它迫使观众放慢脚步，迫使观众去研究这张照片并从中获得感悟。

sentences.en: And I want somebody to stop and look at the photograph and stare at it.
sentences.zh: 我希望有人能停下来，看着这张照片，凝视它。

sentences.en: I want people to stare at that.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们凝视它。

sentences.en: Tower, do you think that the timing of the publication of this photo was in some ways kind
sentences.zh: 泰勒，你认为这张照片发表的时机在某种程度上是否

sentences.en: of accidentally fortuitous in that the world's attention was very suddenly on Yemen because of the assassination of Jamal Khashoggi?
sentences.zh: 是一种偶然的巧合？因为贾迈勒·卡舒吉（Jamal Khashoggi）遇刺，世界的目光突然转向了也门？

sentences.en: And is that what started to draw lots of people's attention to the story?
sentences.zh: 这就是开始吸引大量人关注这个故事的原因吗？

sentences.en: I remember thinking that even as a Times journalist, I wasn't paying much attention to this war until the days after Khashoggi's death.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时作为《时报》的记者，在卡舒吉去世后的几天里，我也没有太关注这场战争。

sentences.en: And suddenly that photograph that you took, and I'm not even sure exactly how many days or weeks before you'd taken it.
sentences.zh: 突然间，你拍的那张照片——我不确定你是在那之前多少天或几周拍的——

sentences.en: Suddenly that was a huge portrait on the front page of the paper.
sentences.zh: 突然就成了报纸头版上的一幅巨幅肖像。

sentences.en: The fact that those coincided, I thought, was good because that brought even that much more attention both to both sides of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这两者恰好重合是件好事，因为它让双方都得到了更多的关注。

sentences.en: And it was a pure coincidence that just a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 那纯粹是一个巧合，仅仅是一个巧合。

sentences.en: And, you know, we want these stories to be recognized.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们希望这些故事能被认可。

sentences.en: We want people to pay attention to them.
sentences.zh: 我们希望人们关注它们。

sentences.en: And the fact that we were in Yemen working and seeing a lot of the problems that were happening because of this Saudi-led war at the same time that Khashoggi was killed
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在也门工作，看到了很多因为这场沙特领导的战争而发生的问题，与此同时卡舒吉被

sentences.en: by Saudi Arabia was only brought that much more attention to what was happening.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯杀害，这让人们更加关注正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: You know, that brings up something interesting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这引出了一个有趣的话题。

sentences.en: You know, people would ask me and ask Declan Walsh, the correspondent who I was working with there, you know, why do people care so much about this
sentences.zh: 人们会问我，也会问和我一起在那里的记者德克兰·沃尔什（Declan Walsh），为什么人们对这个

sentences.en: one person, Khashoggi, who was killed when we have all these people getting killed here every day, children suffering, starving to death?
sentences.zh: 被杀害的人——卡舒吉——如此关心，而我们这里每天都有这么多人被杀，孩子们在受苦，在活活饿死？

sentences.en: You know, that's a bit difficult to explain to people that it's not just about the death of one person, that his life was worth more than anyone else's life,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很难向人们解释，这不仅仅是一个人的死亡，也不是说他的生命比任何人的生命都更有价值，

sentences.en: but the nature of how that was carried out and how that is a metaphor for how Saudi Arabia does business and how they deal with conflict.
sentences.zh: 而是这种行为的性质，以及它是沙特阿拉伯行事方式及其处理冲突方式的隐喻。

sentences.en: Everyone is suffering in different ways from this or dying in different ways from this.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在以不同的方式遭受这场战争的苦难，或者以不同的方式死于这场战争。

sentences.en: But I would hope that this photograph largely brings recognition and help to a place that is in desperate need of it.
sentences.zh: 但我希望这张照片能在很大程度上为这个急需帮助的地方带来认可和援助。

sentences.en: Tyler, thank you very much for coming in and talking to us.
sentences.zh: 泰勒，非常感谢你来和我们交谈。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me on the show.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我参加节目。

sentences.en: Since the beginning of the war, an estimated 85,000 children in Yemen have died of starvation, and millions more are considered at risk.
sentences.zh: 自战争开始以来，据估计也门有85,000名儿童死于饥饿，另有数百万人处于危险之中。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the United Nations convened both sides of the war in Sweden to try to broker peace.
sentences.zh: 周四，联合国在瑞典召集了战争双方，试图促成和平。

sentences.en: Let us be in no doubt that Yemen's future is in the hands of those of us in this room.
sentences.zh: 让我们毫无疑问，也门的未来掌握在我们这些在座的人手中。

sentences.en: The coming days are a milestone.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天是一个里程碑。

sentences.en: It's an important, it's a significant event.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重要的、意义重大的事件。

sentences.en: Don't waver.
sentences.zh: 不要动摇。

sentences.en: Let us not, none of us waver in spite of the challenges that we may face.
sentences.zh: 无论我们可能面临什么样的挑战，让我们都不要动摇。

sentences.en: Let us work with goodwill, good faith, and with energy and commitment and conviction, and I'm sure we will deliver a message of peace for the people in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 让我们以善意、诚信、精力和承诺以及信念去工作，我相信我们一定会为也门人民传递出和平的信息。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: It's been a bad morning.
sentences.zh: 这是一个糟糕的早晨。

sentences.en: The Dow is down more than 500 points and that puts it below the point which it started the year, meaning all those gains have now been wiped off the market.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯指数下跌超过500点，这使其跌破了年初的水平，意味着所有的涨幅现在都已从市场上抹去。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the arrest of a Chinese technology executive at the direction of the Trump administration deepened fears that the trade war between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，一名中国科技高管在特朗普政府的指示下被捕，加剧了人们对美中贸易战

sentences.en: and China will intensify, sending stock prices plunging for the second time this week.
sentences.zh: 将升级的担忧，导致股价本周第二次暴跌。

sentences.en: This is all associated with the arrest of Meng Wanzhou, the chief financial officer of the Chinese telco giant Huawei.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与中国电信巨头华为的首席财务官孟晚舟被捕有关。

sentences.en: She was arrested in Canada at the request of lawmakers here in the United States, and they want to see her extradited to face charges.
sentences.zh: 她在加拿大应美国立法者的要求被捕，他们希望将她引渡回国接受指控。

sentences.en: Meng Wanzhou was arrested on Saturday, the same day that President Trump and President Xi negotiated a truce in a months-long battle of tariffs and counter-tariffs.
sentences.zh: 孟晚舟是在周六被捕的，就在同一天，特朗普总统和习近平主席就长达数月的关税和反关税之争达成了休战协议。

sentences.en: Currently, there is a 90-day ceasefire in that trade war, but this shows how volatile and how fragile the relationship between Beijing and Washington is.
sentences.zh: 目前，贸易战有90天的停火期，但这显示了北京和华盛顿之间的关系是多么不稳定和脆弱。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has not identified the charges against Meng, but the Times reports that prosecutors have been investigating whether her company, Huawei, has violated U.S.
sentences.zh: 尚未确定对孟晚舟的指控，但《时报》报道称，检察官一直在调查她的公司华为是否通过向伊朗运送源自美国的

sentences.en: sanctions against Iran by shipping products to Iran that originated in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 产品，违反了美国对伊朗的制裁。

sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格（Samantha Hennig）是我们的编辑总监。

sentences.zh: 我们的技术经理是布拉德·费舍尔（Brad Fisher）。

sentences.zh: 我们的工程师是克里斯（Chris）

sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆（Sam）

sentences.zh: 多尔曼（Dolman）、米凯拉·布沙尔（Michaela Bouchard）和斯特拉·谭（Stella Tan）。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》（Metro）的最新一集中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig），讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
